name: Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences Ltd
about: Krishna Medical Institution Ltd (KIMS) was Incorporated in the year 1973 and is one of the largest corporate healthcare groups in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana in terms of patients treated and treatments offered. The company offers multidisciplinary healthcare services with primary, secondary, and tertiary care across 2-3 tier cities and an additional quaternary healthcare facility in tier-1 cities.
keyPoints: Regional Leadership:[1][2] KIMS Hospitals is one of the largest corporate healthcare groups in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh, offering multi-disciplinary integrated healthcare with a focus on tertiary and quaternary care at affordable cost. The group today currently runs 26 hospitals across 5 states - Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Maharashtra, Karnataka, and Kerala (with a 6th state, Tamil Nadu, on the drawing board for Chennai)- and offers 40+ specialty services, including Cardiac Sciences, Oncology, Neuro sciences, Organ Transplantation, and Maternal & Child Health.
pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Company's median sales growth is 21.9% of last 10 years
cons: Stock is trading at 8.13 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -6.20%

announcements.text: KIMS Swastha Private Limited ('KSPL'), Wholly-Owned Subsidiary Of The Krishna Institute Of Medical Sciences Limited ('Company') Has Entered Into An Operations And Management Agreement With LOVR Institute Of Medical Sciences Limited 14 Nov - KIMS subsidiary signed 10-year O&M agreement for Thrissur’s Westfort Hi-Tech Hospital, effective 4 Nov 2026.
